headline.text: L1 found *foreign material* in almonds overnight—line down for 4-hour allergy clean, product on hold pending investigation.

per_plant_summary.L1: S2 ran through multiple high-temper cycles that resolved shift by shift, then QA found suspected insect larvae in almonds at 02:28—line is down for allergy clean as of 07:10. S3 completed a caramel deposit trial and replaced a delaminating belt.
per_plant_summary.L2: ML2 had a stuck agitator knob (cleared in 8 minutes) and replaced a peeling drive belt. ML3 fought depositor chocolate buildup through 2nd shift and snapped a drive belt overnight—belt replaced and line restarted by 05:30.
per_plant_summary.L3: Truffle line adjusted Cavanna jaws in the morning, ran out of V2 flow wrap at 17:34 but staged V3 and resumed depositing by 19:50. ML1 replaced depositor agitator bushings. MF Matrix and ML4 ran clean.

resolved.title: S2 recurring high temper readings
resolved.summary: Enrober temper spiked above 1.0 multiple times through 1st shift, requiring line stops and adjustments to mini-tempering unit and mass cooling.
resolved.resolution: Stabilized after repeated adjustments; final reading 0.8 at 12:48 and line ran through end of 1st shift (S2 Enrober).

resolved.title: Metal detector air supply shut off
resolved.summary: Detector tested correctly but reject mechanism didn't open; maintenance found air supply valve closed.
resolved.resolution: Air restored, detector detected and opened correctly on retest (Mariela Gudino, 07:28).

resolved.title: S3 C22 belt delaminating
resolved.summary: C22 belt showing delamination; maintenance replacing belt and will require ATP/allergen retest.
resolved.resolution: All jar system for S3 complete including C5-18 by 16:03 (Nathan Topham).

resolved.title: MM8 printer control board failure
resolved.summary: MM8 printer down; VideoJet vendor dispatched for on-site repair.
resolved.resolution: Control board replaced by VideoJet, printer back up and running at 14:00 (Troy Baxter).

resolved.title: S2 enrober filter missing locking clip
resolved.summary: Operator found filter not assembled correctly and missing the locking clip during inspection.
resolved.resolution: Operator assembled filter correctly with clip (Victor Romero Sr., 15:09).

resolved.title: ML3 flow wrap sensor fault (PG45/PG46)
resolved.summary: Line stopped; maintenance called to resolve PG45 and PG46 sensor issues on flow wrapper.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 11:40 — "The line is running" (Molding Line 3 Pack).

resolved.title: ML3 sensor B31 triggering line stop
resolved.summary: Line stopped due to sensor B31 fault; maintenance on-site troubleshooting.
resolved.resolution: Sensor issue resolved, line running at 13:18 (Molding Line 3 Pack).

resolved.title: ML3 drive belt snapped on rear motor
resolved.summary: Drive belt on back far right drive motor failed; depositor emptied end of 2nd shift.
resolved.resolution: Belt replaced by maintenance, depositing started at 05:30 (Fernando Flores, Molding Line 3 Filler).

resolved.title: ML2 double belt drive side peeling
resolved.summary: Drive-side belt on double belt system delaminating, creating jams; maintenance replaced belt.
resolved.resolution: New belt cleaned, passed ATP, installed, and line running at 06:51 (Zack Kurtz, Victor Leandro).

resolved.title: ML3 down ramp cycling intermittently
resolved.summary: Down ramp triggering every few minutes, getting worse; performed CIL to attempt fix.
resolved.resolution: Down ramp stable after CIL; only one trigger in 30 minutes vs. every few minutes before (Brandon Lance, 20:06).

resolved.title: ML3 depositor chocolate buildup
resolved.summary: Chocolate building up on depositor back and around blades, causing deposit issues; pulled and cleaned twice.
resolved.resolution: Line running fine after second cleaning at 21:08 (Brandon Lance).

resolved.title: ML2 caramel tank agitator not spinning
resolved.summary: Agitator motor in caramel holding tank stopped turning; maintenance called to investigate.
resolved.resolution: Potentiometer knob stuck on inside, freed and agitator working again at 04:25 (Gustavo Rodas, Fernando Flores).

resolved.title: Ran out of V2 flow wrap mid-shift
resolved.summary: Line paused at 17:34 waiting for FW 40793-V3 after consuming all V2 packaging.
resolved.resolution: V3 arrived at 19:33, depositing restarted at 19:50 — "We've started depositing" (Nathan Gevenois).

resolved.title: Cavanna jaw pressure causing open units
resolved.summary: Maintenance adjusted jaw pressure and backlash on Cavanna 1 to eliminate open units in flow wrap.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 11:31 — "Adjusted jaw pressure and backlash no more open units being produced and they look a lot better" (Nathan Ruiz).

resolved.title: ML1 depositor agitator bushings worn
resolved.summary: Maintenance replacing worn agitator bushings on depositor.
resolved.resolution: Depositor back in place with new bushings at 06:11 (Kavin Ayala).

resolved.title: Tempermeter not printing test results
resolved.summary: Tempermeter system failed to print out temper test documentation.

needs_attention.title: Foreign material found in almonds—line down for allergy clean
needs_attention.summary: QA found almond with suspected insect damage and mold at 02:28, then gray/tan fiber-like material resembling larvae in multiple pallets across lot numbers; all production from 02:00 onward on hold.
needs_attention.status: Line down since 04:24, emptying chocolate from melting tanks (both empty as of 07:10), 4-hour allergy clean in progress, product hold active pending investigation completion.
